svg.title: Davids Platform — .NET 10 Microservices, Infrastructure, Repository Relationships and Security Architecture
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing all seven standalone .NET 10 Davids repositories, Clean Architecture project layers, Dual-Authority OpenIddict RS256 OIDC PKCE and YARP Confidential BFF flows, physically isolated SQL Server databases, Redis, RabbitMQ, HashiCorp Vault KV-v2 bootstrap, Prometheus/Jaeger/Grafana/Seq observability, Istio STRICT mTLS service mesh, and the five lifecycle security verification stages.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Davids Platform — .NET 10 Microservices, Infrastructure & Security Architecture

svg.text: 7 Standalone Repositories (.slnx) · Dual OpenIddict RS256 OIDC (PKCE S256) · YARP Confidential Admin BFF · 3 Isolated SQL DBs · Istio STRICT mTLS & eBPF
